meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页打磨得更美观、更规范,同时兼顾性能与无障碍。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常做前端界面调整,却不太确定设计是否好看。
copy.tagline_en: Polish web pages to be more elegant, consistent, and accessible.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often tweak frontend interfaces but are unsure about design taste.

howto.what: 处理网页界面(UI/UX)工作时,它会先挑选并阅读对应的设计规范,要求先写 DESIGN.md 设计文档再写代码;用真实浏览器跑 Lighthouse 审计,查配色/字体数据库,参照 beui.dev 交互目录与真实网页截图做研究,最终产出设计方案和代码。
howto.when: 当你说到前端、UI、设计等词,或要求重设计页面、照某品牌风格做、做性能或无障碍审计时触发。

say.text: 照 Stripe 的风格重做这个落地页,先建 DESIGN.md
say.note: 会读 Stripe 品牌参考,先写设计契约再写代码

say.text: 给按钮加悬停动效,并查一下无障碍问题
say.note: 会去 beui.dev 找相近交互模式再动手

say.text: 用 Lighthouse 审计这个 React 项目的性能
say.note: 用 Playwright 真实浏览器跑 3-5 次取中位数

howto.what_en: Routes UI/UX work through four rulesets: reads design references, requires DESIGN.md before code, audits Lighthouse via real Playwright Chromium, consults ui-ux-db and beui.dev, and delivers design docs plus code.
howto.when_en: Triggered by frontend/UI/design keywords, or asks to redesign/restyle, add motion, match a brand (Linear, Stripe), run Lighthouse/perf audits, or build a mockup.

say_en.text: Redo this landing page in Stripe's style; create DESIGN.md first.
say_en.note: Reads the Stripe brand file, writes the design contract, then codes.

say_en.text: Add a hover micro-interaction to this button and check accessibility.
say_en.note: Sources a matching beui.dev pattern and honors reduced motion.

say_en.text: Audit this React project's performance with Lighthouse.
say_en.note: Runs real Playwright Chromium 3-5 times and takes the median.
